name: Brex
summary: Spend management and financial services platform for companies.
overview: Brex combines cards, expense management, payments, and treasury products.
bull_case: Embedded spend controls can make Brex part of the finance operating system.
bear_case: Fintech competition and sensitivity to startup spending can make growth volatile.

intelligence.description: Brex provides corporate cards, spend management, and treasury products for businesses.
company: Brex built a financial platform combining corporate cards, spend controls, and cash-management products for businesses.
Capital One completed its $5.15 billion cash-and-stock acquisition of Brex in April 2026.
intelligence.why_it_matters: The transaction is an important fintech exit signal: a major bank is buying software-led business-payments infrastructure rather than building it internally.

changed.text: Capital One completed its $5.15B acquisition of Brex.

takeaways: Brex is now an acquisition profile, not a standalone IPO candidate.
The deal illustrates strategic demand for business-payments infrastructure.
Integration into Capital One is the primary watch item.
